verdict.rationale: RudderStack's compliance toolkit claims it can 'block, mask, or encrypt PII before it gets downstream' (docs-63). Its Transformations filter and reshape event data before it reaches destinations (docs-49, docs-57), which supports field-level removal of sensitive attributes. However, the evidence is marketing-level only. It never explicitly ties these controls to individual destinations or mentions hashing, and the transformation route relies on custom code. Missing for 10: explicit per-destination PII policy configuration, documented hashing support, in-depth docs on the masking/blocking feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.
